facts.fact: Newswatch reports that Nigeria's Cloud First Policy was introduced in 2019 to encourage ministries, departments and agencies to adopt cloud computing and reduce dependence on costly, fragmented data centres, and that the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative builds on it.

Newswatch reports that the government has introduced national cloud computing and technical guidelines, with a digital infrastructure assurance framework, to support the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative; no date is given, so the published date 2026-09-12 is used.
facts.system: National cloud computing and technical guidelines
